hypotheses.title: Off-catalogue USGS SGMC geologic-map fault traces, dot-thinned to the credit bar
layers: external/derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.tif (USGS SGMC 1:24k/1:250k geologic-map faults rasterised to the competition grid; hash-pinned mirror in buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE24, sha256 643cbe992ef4ba37588fb469163ed8291e3ceb23d6c1f78a3cfaa462430c2da0)
labels.tif / existing_faults.tif (competition catalogue = USGS/INGENIOUS compilation; byte-identical pair, sha256 7ba308ccdc4418b31a178f4f1ef21aaa6e152e4028f2f6f64b01f7eb25ae4093)
hypotheses.signature: binary trace presence on the 100 m grid, dilated 1 px (to sit inside the 300 m kernel of a 1 px-wide truth line), Poisson-disk thinned at min_dist = 2.8 px (280 m) so no two dots compete for the same truth pixel; catalogue pixels masked pixel-exactly at scoring time
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: the SGMC geologic-map compilation contains Quaternary structures never ingested into the USGS Quaternary Fault & Fold Database that supplies the competition labels, so its traces are, by construction, a sample of faults missing from the catalogue
hypotheses.mimic_process: lithologic and map-unit boundaries drawn as fault linework on geologic maps (non-tectonic contacts mimicking faults)
hypotheses.how_it_differs: the GEMSDOE32/24 H41/SGMC arms emitted catalogue vectors without an off-catalogue restriction and lost their secondary proxy; this arm emits only catalogue-excluded traces from an independent map compilation, dot-thinned and evaluated on the spatially-blocked holdout. Not present on any sister GEMSDOE site.
hypotheses.expected_dti: holdout-DTI 0.1885 (drift-corrected mean), 95% CI [0.1658, 0.2113], all 4 quadrants positive, on_catalogue_pixels = 0, leakage-canary AUC = 0.498 (no leakage); TMI-gradient variant H72-2 measured 0.0046 (negative)
hypotheses.cost: low (one 198 KB raster + distance/thinning primitives already in the template)
hypotheses.data_status: VERIFIED OBTAINABLE: hash-pinned owner mirror reachable via the GitHub API from this sandbox (restored and sha256-verified)
hypotheses.status: PROMOTE - packaged as submission gemsdoe72-h72-1-sgmc-offcatalogue-20261020T195456Z-6e6525e5 (zeros + nan variants, 12-point format audit passed)

hypotheses.title: Aeromagnetic horizontal-gradient lineaments (GeoDAWN TMI tmi_hg band), top-k off-catalogue

hypotheses.signature: threshold/top-k of the magnetic-gradient magnitude edge field; concealed faults offset magnetic basement and produce gradient edges with no surface expression
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: concealed or blind faults have no surface trace and are under-represented in a surface-expression catalogue
hypotheses.mimic_process: intrusive contacts and lithologic boundaries also produce magnetic gradient edges
hypotheses.how_it_differs: no sister site publication uses the tmi_hg band as an emission field; the reference solution uses all 19 bands in a U-Net but never reports a holdout-DTI for single-band gradient emission
hypotheses.expected_dti: holdout-DTI 0.0046 at budget 8,000 (NEGATIVE - no signal on this proxy truth); kept on record as a ruled-out candidate
hypotheses.cost: low (one band of the restored stack)

hypotheses.title: Catalogue fault-tip and releasing step-over growth arms
layers: labels.tif (visible faults only - holdout-compliant: derived from visible faults in each draw)
hypotheses.signature: skeletonise visible fault traces; extend short growth arms at trace endpoints and at releasing-bend step-overs (relay-ramp damage zones, the permeability target of geothermal systems)
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: a fault tip is by definition beyond the end of the mapped trace, so growth arms land off-catalogue by construction
hypotheses.mimic_process: random tip scatter has no geologic basis; could mimic noise lineaments
hypotheses.how_it_differs: GEMSDOE32 H33-5 registered this as a tip/step-over operator and falsified it as an addition arm (+0.0019 LM, 7x too expensive per dot) but never built it as a standalone lane; this registry entry builds it standalone
hypotheses.expected_dti: unmeasured; expected small (tip population is ~1-2% of catalogue mass)
hypotheses.data_status: no external data needed; not yet built
